privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {{company}} collects through the Klipp website, the agency portal and the Klipp mobile app, why it is collected and what your rights are.

controller.title: 1. Data controller
controller.body:
The data controller is {{company}}, with its registered office at {{address}}.
For any question about your data, you can contact us at {{email}}.

data.title: 2. Data we collect
data.body:
Website: no personal data is collected apart from the preference cookies described below.

Agency portal: when you create and use your account, we collect the agency name, the manager's name, email address, phone number, postal address and password.

Agents and offices: the information your agency enters about its agents (photo, name, email, phone) and its offices (photo, name, address, email, phone).

purposes.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
purposes.body:
• Creating and managing your agency account — performance of contract.
• Displaying your agents and offices in the Klipp app — performance of contract.
• Service security and abuse prevention — legitimate interest.
• Remembering your preferences (theme, language) — consent.

retention.title: 4. Retention
retention.body:
Account data is kept for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account from your profile, your data and that of your agents and offices is deleted, subject to legal retention obligations.
Preference cookies are kept for a maximum of 12 months.

recipients.title: 5. Recipients and hosting
recipients.body:
Your data is intended solely for {{company}} and is never sold. It is hosted by {{host}}.
Where data is transferred outside the European Union, the transfer is covered by appropriate safeguards, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
cookies.body:
We use no advertising or analytics cookies.

• cookie_consent — remembers your cookie choice (12 months).
• theme — remembers light or dark theme, only if you accepted cookies (12 months).
• i18next — remembers your language, only if you accepted cookies (12 months).

When you are signed in to the agency portal, your session token is kept in your browser's local storage. It is strictly necessary for the service to work and is removed when you sign out.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.body:
Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port and object to the processing of your data, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time.
To exercise these rights, write to {{email}}. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

security.title: 8. Security
security.body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration. Traffic between your browser and our servers is encrypted (HTTPS).

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. If we make significant changes, we will notify you by email or through the agency portal.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern access to and use of the Klipp website, the agency portal and the Klipp mobile app. By using our services, you accept them in full.

publisher.title: 1. Publisher and host
publisher.body:
The service is published by {{company}}, with its registered office at {{address}}. Contact: {{email}}.
Publication director: {{director}}.
The website is hosted by {{host}}.

service.title: 2. The service
service.body: Klipp is a real estate search app. The agency portal lets real estate agencies manage their profile, agents and offices, and view their statistics.

account.title: 3. Agency account
account.body:
Agency accounts are reserved for real estate professionals. You agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for all activity on your account. Notify us promptly of any unauthorised use.

obligations.title: 4. Agency obligations
obligations.body:
You agree to use the service lawfully and not to publish any unlawful or misleading content, or content that infringes the rights of others.
When you add agents, you warrant that you have informed them and have a legal basis to publish their data (photo, name, contact details).

ip.title: 5. Intellectual property
ip.body:
The Klipp brand, website, app and all their content (text, visuals, logos, code) are the property of {{company}}. Any reproduction without permission is prohibited.
You keep the rights to the content you publish and grant us a non-exclusive licence to display it as part of the service.

liability.title: 6. Liability
liability.body:
We strive to keep the service available and working properly but cannot guarantee it absolutely. The service may be interrupted for maintenance or in case of force majeure.
{{company}} is not liable for content published by agencies or for indirect damages resulting from use of the service.

termination.title: 7. Suspension and termination
termination.body: You can delete your account at any time from your profile. We may suspend or delete an account that breaches these terms, after notifying the agency where possible.

data.title: 8. Personal data
data.body: How we process your personal data is described in our privacy policy.

changes.title: 9. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may change these terms at any time. New terms apply as soon as they are published on this page. If we make significant changes, we will notify you in advance.

law.title: 10. Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, an amicable solution will be sought first; failing that, the French courts shall have sole jurisdiction.
